profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA. Its website presents it primarily as a platform for AI developers, describing tools and models available through the Meta Model API, which the site notes is compatible with existing OpenAI SDK clients. The site highlights several AI products: Muse Spark, described as a coding-optimized model that writes, reviews, and ships code with fewer steps and lower latency; Muse Code, a coding agent built to run Muse Spark; and Muse Glimmer, described as a 30-billion-parameter open model optimized for local agent workflows and small enough to run on a Mac or PC with a single consumer GPU. The site also references multi-agent workflow capabilities and a search grounding tool that gives models live web access.

Meta's tracked AI product is Llama, an open-weight model family that is often self-hosted, available at llama.com. The company reported revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the period ending 2025-12-31 per a 10-K filing, and trades publicly under the ticker META with a CIK of 0001326801.

The held facts include two active cases in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California: Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc. and Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. Several third-party MCP servers built around Meta's advertising infrastructure also appear in the registry, covering campaign management, creative testing, and performance analysis across Facebook and Instagram.
